Name: Sexy Valley
Author: ApryllForever
Description:
[center][size=6]Sexy Valley[/size][/center]

Sexier portraits and sprites! The goal is to include all adult female portraits, currently only those listed below are fixed, with more incoming as I have time.

Everyone has swim looks, and in most cases, winter looks also.

[color=#ff00ff]Maru[/color] - Mermaid themed all around! Overalls, no shirt for main look. Options for glasses, no glasses, larger eyes. Scrubs for hospital sprite and portrait. Made her sprites overall look more like her portraits. Wedding dress: Mermaid dress!!!!! Deep v-neck halter, mermaid line, with matching Tiara!!! Spring dress: Made it floral themed, with Water Lilly for her hair! Her swimsuit is also mermaid themed: aquamarine stone on pearl! Her winter look is Winter-Star themed, along with matching Star Necklace!

[color=#9900ff]Abigail [/color]- Removed the hairbow in most cases. Sprites taller and fiercer. Wedding dress: Sweetheart neckline, A-Line skirt. Green and Yellow flowers on her Spring Dance Dress, to match her bow.

[color=#ffff00]Haley[/color] - Sprites a little taller. No socks. Added lipstick. Portrait: changed the lipstick color, gave her a push-up bra, and fiddled with her hair a little. Wedding Dress: Sweetheart neckline, ballgown skirt, with sparkles! (There should ALWAYS be more sparkles!) Pink flowers on her spring dance dress. 

[color=#ff0000]Leah [/color]- Taller, improved Crop Top. Wedding Dress: Halter top, mermaid line. Spaghetti strap spring dress, with pretty green matching flower!

[color=#00ffff]Emily - [/color][color=#616161] [/color]Hair fixes. Now worships Moon Goddesses (changed the Yoba sign to a Crescent of Artemis: she's a witch lol!). Fixed her red dress, made the sprites sexier. Wedding Dress: Strapless classic A-Line, spring dress spaghetti straps, hibiscus-inspired, with a hibiscus in her hair!

[color=#00ff00]Caroline [/color]- Improved the hair style, gave her a nice hoodie, fixed her swimsuit. (Goth marryable Caroline coming in the future).

Working on Penny, just wanted to get this out, cause a lot is going on in my life right now, and will be super busy! 

Pls let me know if you have any requests!
